title: Normal - Standby
fullDescription: Heil furnaces (ICP brand, shared with Tempstar, Comfortmaker, Day & Night) use slow/fast flashes. A single slow flash is normal standby.
symptoms: Unit ready, no call for heat

fixSteps.title: None
fixSteps.instruction: No action.

title: External Lockout - Retry/Recycle Exceeded
shortDescription: Furnace locked out after repeated ignition failures.
fullDescription: After three ignition attempts or five recycles, the board locks out and flashes twice. Root cause is typically flame sensor, igniter, or gas supply.
safetyWarning: Smell gas? Evacuate and call utility.

fixSteps.title: Cycle power
fixSteps.instruction: Off 60s, on.

fixSteps.title: Clean flame sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Polish with fine emery.

title: Pressure Switch Problem
shortDescription: Pressure switch open with inducer on, or closed with inducer off.
fullDescription: 3 flashes mean the pressure switch is in the wrong state. Check vents, condensate, and switch hose.

fixSteps.title: Clear vents
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect outside termination.

title: Limit Switch Open
fullDescription: Plenum overheat condition. Check filter, airflow, blower.
safetyWarning: Repeated overheating can damage heat exchanger.

fixSteps.title: Change filter
fixSteps.instruction: Fresh filter, open registers.

title: Flame Sensed with No Call
shortDescription: Board detects flame when gas should be off.
fullDescription: This is a serious safety: flame signal present with gas valve de-energized. Usually stuck gas valve or board relay fault.
safetyWarning: Stuck gas valve - immediate shut-off of gas supply; call pro.
symptoms: Burners lit with no call for heat

fixSteps.title: Shut off gas, call pro
fixSteps.instruction: Close manual gas valve, leave furnace off.

title: Rollout Switch Open
fullDescription: Manual-reset rollout opened. Check for blocked heat exchanger/flue.
safetyWarning: Do not reset without combustion inspection - CO hazard.

fixSteps.title: Call pro
fixSteps.instruction: Schedule combustion inspection.

title: Flame Signal Too Low
fullDescription: Occasional low flame signal indicates sensor fouling or marginal flame.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Polish with emery.

title: Ignition Circuit Fault
fullDescription: Board reports the igniter is open, shorted, or drawing wrong current.

fixSteps.title: Test resistance
fixSteps.instruction: 40-90 ohms cold.

title: Reversed Polarity / Low Voltage
shortDescription: Line polarity reversed or incoming voltage low.
fullDescription: Flame rectification requires correct polarity. Board flashes 9 when it can't verify polarity or secondary voltage is low.

fixSteps.title: Check polarity
fixSteps.instruction: Outlet tester or meter.

title: Gas Heat Lockout
fullDescription: Board commanded gas valve but didn't confirm current flow. Valve coil or wiring fault.

fixSteps.title: Call pro
fixSteps.instruction: Gas valve diagnosis.

title: Standby / No Faults
fullDescription: One-then-one flashes (slow blink) means no fault — normal operation.

title: Blower After Power Up
shortDescription: Blower runs to clear furnace after power restored.
fullDescription: Twelve flashes is informational — blower running 90 seconds post-power-on.

title: Limit Circuit Lockout
shortDescription: Limit switch opened too many times.
fullDescription: Thirteen flashes is the limit circuit lockout — clear airflow and reset.

title: Gas Heating Lockout
shortDescription: Gas heat lockout after failed ignition.
fullDescription: Code 21 is a gas heat circuit lockout — typical ignition issue.

title: Pressure Switch Stuck Closed
shortDescription: Pressure switch closed before inducer ran.
fullDescription: Twenty-two flashes — switch stuck closed.

title: Pressure Switch Open
shortDescription: Inducer running but switch not proving.
fullDescription: Twenty-three flashes — vent or inducer issue.

title: Rollout Switch Open
fullDescription: Code 25 — rollout switch opened. Do not reset until inspected.

title: High Pressure Switch (HP)
shortDescription: HP unit high pressure switch open.
fullDescription: Code 31 on Heil heat pump combo — high refrigerant pressure.

title: Polarity Reversed
fullDescription: Code 41 indicates reversed polarity at the furnace.

title: Control Board Failure
fullDescription: Forty-five flashes indicates control board hardware failure — replace.

faq.a: Power-cycle once; if persists, board replacement.

title: Flame sense
fullDescription: Weak or no flame signal. Common diagnostic code on Heil furnace. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure for the implicated subsystem.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power for 10 minutes, then restore.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the implicated component, wiring, and connectors.

fixSteps.title: Test/replace
fixSteps.instruction: Test sensor with multimeter or replace if reading abnormal.

fixSteps.title: Verify
fixSteps.instruction: Restore power, clear codes, run system to verify.

safetyWarning: Gas/electric appliance — turn off gas and disconnect electrical power before servicing.
whenToCallPro: Gas-appliance work usually requires licensed HVAC tech.

faq.a: Resolve before continued use to prevent damage or safety hazard.
